text: This solution, PNG Disaster Management Reference Handbook (August 2025) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Papua New Guinea between National Disaster Centre (NDC), Government of Papua New Guinea, Papua New Guinea Defence Force, Royal Papua New Guinea Constabulary, Center for Excellence in Disaster Management and Humanitarian Assistance (CFE-DMHA), United Nations, Australia, Japan, New Zealand, and United States. The program was implemented in 2025 and focuses on collaboration and raising awareness.
